title: Old Fashioned American Egg Noodles
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring egg noodles, cured meat, and fresh herbs, perfect for a cozy night in. This keto-friendly recipe is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions until they are al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the cured bacon over medium heat until it is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set it aside on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess grease.
In the same skillet, add the chopped parsley and dill and cook for 1-2 minutes until they are fragrant.
Add the garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the skillet and toss them in the herb and spice mixture until they are well coated.
Crumble the cooked bacon into the skillet and toss everything together until the noodles are evenly coated with the bacon and herbs.
If using grated cheddar cheese, sprinkle it over the top of the noodles and bacon and stir until it is melted and well combined.
Serve the old-fashioned American egg noodles hot and enjoy.
